def transform(grid):
    # Split at the uniform separator. Mark positions where corresponding cells
    # in the two panels have the same color.
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    first, second = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    return [[3 if a == b else 2 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
            for x, y in zip(first, second)]
